title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.0037260455556 (+0.11194% over #7669) with fifteen banked transfer pivots
body:
**Conditional κ ≥ 0.0037260455556.** Fifteen rational changes of sender and receiver basis remove 240 paid recursive calls in the 16-stage construction from SYLforge’s #7669. Every public operator and productive rank count is preserved. The new bound is **0.0000041662072 (0.11194%) above the parent’s directed upper endpoint**. That increment is 1.758 times the incremental step in #7663. The cumulative difference from the selected 0.00363005817 is 2.64424% and includes the work of the predecessor authors. [Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/26b6c469aa6c4aa04322ce25a22150f90e5fb14e/research/p104-banked-transfer-pivots/PROOF.md) · [Signed receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/26b6c469aa6c4aa04322ce25a22150f90e5fb14e/research/p104-banked-transfer-pivots/RESULT.json) · [Parent](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7669) · [Previous step](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7663)

| Quantity | #7669 | This PR |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Paid moves per native call | 6,157 | 6,142 |
| Paid calls in all 16 stages | 102,064 | 101,824 |
| Productive fields | 21,152 | 21,152 |
| Target minus paid rank mass | 1,328 | 1,328 |
| Raw crossing, directed | (0.0037218793483, 0.0037218793484) | (0.00372604555571, 0.00372604555572) |

## Construction

A paid transfer into B can have several consumers sending to the same C. At each of fifteen sites, another sender can form one linear combination of those outgoing rows using its own saved fields and side information at C. Subtract that combination from the other outgoing rows, remove the incoming transfer and recover every old read locally at C. Each witness includes an exact equality on arbitrary independent inputs and a legal schedule. Seven edits use the forward circuit and eight use the transposed scalar circuit. The actual implementation executes the final forward graph. [Fifteen witnesses](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/26b6c469aa6c4aa04322ce25a22150f90e5fb14e/research/p104-banked-transfer-pivots/PIVOTS.json) · [Construction and scheduler](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/26b6c469aa6c4aa04322ce25a22150f90e5fb14e/research/p104-banked-transfer-pivots/network.py)

## Verification

- All 1,501 native output rows agree with the public specification. The checker verifies 8,533,666 exact coefficient products. The signed caller returns 3,536 root roles and 17,616 independent helper jobs.
- The operator replay checks rank, signed Pauli action and absolute phase on 3,024 chart pairs and both adapters on all 104 main ports. All 512 forward and 512 adjoint columns agree on each of the ten distinct new routes at surviving slots.
- Two directed evaluators bracket the full signed crossing. The compiler and input-lift checks pass at 0.00372604555567. All 54 strict and four functional outer predicates pass, with minimum margin 10⁻¹⁵.
- All eight registered checks passed on Python 3.12.16 on arm64 macOS, including in a Git-free export of the 29 committed package and input files. Failure controls cover sender sign, causality, coframes, absolute phase and inexact odd ticks. [Replay manifest](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/26b6c469aa6c4aa04322ce25a22150f90e5fb14e/research/p104-banked-transfer-pivots/VERIFY.json)

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-banked-transfer-pivots
```

## Limitations and review request

The exact-grid realization charges 15,290 private full-field homes per native invocation, or 244,640 per raw caller, plus the public fields and compiler/adapter workspace. The physical proof charges full-extent erasure, ordinary arithmetic, bank selection and restoration with fresh finite constants. It uses the selected five assumptions for uniform native realization, owned erasure, compilation, fixed-tape precision and analytic recovery. A materialized full multiplier and independent scientific review remain open. The separate rounded, fixed-tariff implementation in #7669 has its own service and error obligations. A reviewer can start with witness zero, then check the charged bank schedule and common-root precision substitution in sections 3–4. [Selected application](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/docs/research/pr-intake-evidence/pr7000-application/PROOF-REVIEW.md)
